item.title: Microsoft launches Copilot Tasks: says it can draft replies, book services, track prices, and more
item.description: Microsoft has launched Copilot Tasks in a limited research preview, pitching it as a shift from conversational AI to AI that completes tasks. Users describe a goal in plain language, and Copilot plans and runs multi step workflows across apps and web services, asking for consent before meaningful actions.

item.title: Auqib Nabi becomes top wicket-taker of the season with fifer in Ranji Trophy final vs Karnataka
item.description: J&K pacer Auqib Nabi Dar moves to the top of the bowling charts in the 2025-26 Ranji season with a sensational five-wicket haul in the Ranji Trophy 2025-26 final against Karnataka.

item.title: ‘Ignored Deepak before, invited him after adding ‘Mohammad’ to his name’: Uttarakhand CM Dhami’s swipe at Rahul Gandhi
item.description: Rahul Gandhi met Kotdwar gym trainer Deepak Kumar, now calling himself ‘Mohammad Deepak’, after he defended a Muslim shopkeeper during a communal dispute. Uttarakhand CM Dhami mocked Gandhi’s gesture.

item.title: Ramadan 2026: How to plan balanced and welcoming iftar meal for first-time host
item.description: Hosting Iftar for the first time may turn daunting for you. Here is the guide for the first-time hosts that covers menu planning, smart preparation timeline and balanced dishes to help create a calm, welcoming and well-organised Ramadan gathering at home.

item.title: Yogi govt announces 3-day Holi holiday in UP; salary to be disbursed before festival
item.description: In a directive issued on Friday, the state government stated that employees will get a three-day holiday for Holi from March 2 to 4.

item.title: Sebi drops children’s fund, retirement fund; value & contrarian funds from same AMC now
item.description: On Thursday Sebi published a circular on mutual funds, which has not only created a new MF category but has also discontinued to popular solution-oriented categories such as children’s funds and retirement funds. There have been other changes too that could concern the crores of investors in this expanding world on investments in this country.

item.title: March 2026 Zodiac predictions: Month of growth, clarity and change
item.description: March 2026 brings a transformative energy, guiding every zodiac sign toward clarity and renewed purpose. Expect steady growth, emotional insight, and positive shifts as the month unfolds.

item.title: Youth’s fingers severed in bloody clash over scooter in Rishikesh: One hospitalised, police case registered
item.description: A violent clash broke out between two groups in Rishikesh over a scooter. One youth was seriously injured with severed fingers, while police registered a case and began investigation.

item.title: Karnataka: Canara Bank asks farmer to repay Rs 9.34 loan, he insists on 66 paise change after paying Rs 10
item.description: In a bizarre case reported from Karnataka, a farmer was asked to repay an outstanding loan of Rs 9.34, by Canara Bank. This incident happened in Hassan district of the state. The farmer then paid Rs 10 to the bank and asked them to return his change, thus sending officials into a tizzy.

item.title: Zomato founder hires for Temple wearable, sets body fat rule: 16% for men, and 26% for women
item.description: Deepinder Goyal has opened hiring for Temple, an experimental wearable project aimed at elite performance athletes and brain related tracking. The recruitment spans AI, sensors, embedded systems, and brain computer interface research, and it is drawing attention for a strict fitness bar. Applicants are asked to meet body fat limits of 16% for men and 26% for women, or commit to hitting the target in three months.
